Prompt: POV handheld shot from someone in the audience filming with a phone camera from the third row, frame slightly unsteady, raised above other people’s heads. The scene shows a massive open-air stage where a warrior holding a giant wooden brush faces off against a towering origami colossus. The origami monster stomps its feet, sending a shockwave of sharp paper folds slicing across the white stage floor. The artist rapidly spins the enormous brush, creating a swirling vortex shield of thick black ink that absorbs the paper attacks. Dramatic, fast-paced orchestral string music plays through the venue's audio system. The audience gasps, some leaning forward in shock. With a powerful, two-handed swing, the artist flings the accumulated ink shield forward as a massive, horizontal wave that completely smothers the monster, turning its pristine white body pitch-black and causing it to immediately go limp and collapse. Loud applause and amazed murmurs fill the air

[Hilo 4] Esto es demasiado divertido, aquí hay otro. Princesa de Hielo V.S Oni Furioso. Sería una locura si las actuaciones teatrales fueran así de locas. Prompt: POV handheld shot from someone in the audience filming with a phone camera from the third row, frame slightly unsteady, raised above other people’s heads. The scene shows an expansive tundra-style stage where a lone ice sorceress faces off against a towering, crimson-skinned demon. The demon roars, unleashing a torrential wave of hellfire from its mouth and feet across the icy floor. The sorceress slams her hands down, raising a massive, hyper-reflective wall of cracked ice sheets from the back of the stage to block the inferno. The crowd screams in suspense, cameras shaking slightly. The ice wall acts as a perfect lens, refracting the heat and focusing it right back at the monster with double the intensity; unable to withstand its own redirected power, the oni collapses to the ground and instantly bursts into a spectacular cloud of roaring flames.
